parameters.name: ApisecStatus
parameters.description:
The API security status. Valid values: 
- **1**: enabled.
- **0**: disabled.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.description: The name of the protected object group to which the protected object is added.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: The name of the protected object.
